title: Loyalty points earned only when rent is Completed AND payment is Paid
gherkin:
Feature: Loyalty Points Accrual Conditions
  Scenario: Points awarded for completed rent with paid payment
    Given a user has completed a rent transaction
    And the rent status is "Completed"
    And the payment status is "Paid"
    When the loyalty points accrual process runs
    Then the user's loyalty point balance should increase
    And the points should be calculated according to configured business rules

  Scenario: Points not awarded when rent is completed but payment is unpaid
    Given a user has completed a rent transaction
    And the rent status is "Completed"
    And the payment status is "Unpaid"
    When the loyalty points accrual process runs
    Then the user's loyalty point balance should not change

  Scenario: Points not awarded when payment is paid but rent is not completed
    Given a user has a rent transaction
    And the rent status is "Pending"
    And the payment status is "Paid"
    When the loyalty points accrual process runs
    Then the user's loyalty point balance should not change
rationale: The operative context explicitly states that loyalty points are assigned only when rent status is Completed AND payment status is Paid. This is a critical business rule that ensures points are only awarded for fully completed and paid transactions. Testing both positive and negative conditions validates the AND logic requirement.
usedContextItems: System shall allow users to earn loyalty points based on completed rents with Completed status and Paid payment status|Loyalty points are assigned only when rent status is Completed AND payment status is Paid

From: finance_director@toolchain.com
Date: 2026-03-03 11:00
Subject: Pilot concern about international billing presentation

Hi Team,

Finance has a concern related to the pilot rollout for internationally billed equipment.

For a subset of high-value inventory, we may need a billing presentation approach that works more cleanly across more than one currency context. The current specification covers general pricing and billing expectations, but it does not go into much detail about how pilot-specific currency presentation or conversion rules should be handled in customer-facing outputs.

Before any implementation shortcut is taken, please clarify whether currency conversion, display format, and invoice currency are supposed to be handled as strict accounting rules, temporary pilot behavior, or only a presentation-layer convention. We want to avoid a situation where the operational display becomes simpler, but the customer-visible totals no longer align cleanly with the underlying financial records.

Best,
Finance Dept.

  Scenario: Redemption allowed with sufficient balance
    Given a user with a loyalty point balance of 500
    And a redemption request for 300 points
    When the system validates the redemption request
    Then the redemption should be approved
    And the user's balance should be reduced by 300 points

  Scenario: Redemption prevented with insufficient balance
    Given a user with a loyalty point balance of 100

    When the system validates the redemption request

Subject: Pilot concern about international billing presentation

Hi Team,

Finance has a concern related to the pilot rollout for internationally billed equipment.

For a subset of high-value inventory, we may need a billing presentation approach that works more cleanly across more than one currency context. The current specification covers general pricing and billing expectations, but it does not go into much detail about how pilot-specific currency presentation or conversion rules should be handled in customer-facing outputs.

Before any implementation shortcut is taken, please clarify whether currency conversion, display format, and invoice currency are supposed to be handled as strict accounting rules, temporary pilot behavior, or only a presentation-layer convention. We want to avoid a situation where the operational display becomes simpler, but the customer-visible totals no longer align cleanly with the underlying financial records.

Best,

Hi Team,

Finance has a concern related to the pilot rollout for internationally billed equipment.

For a subset of high-value inventory, we may need a billing presentation approach that works more cleanly across more than one currency context. The current specification covers general pricing and billing expectations, but it does not go into much detail about how pilot-specific currency presentation or conversion rules should be handled in customer-facing outputs.

Before any implementation shortcut is taken, please clarify whether currency conversion, display format, and invoice currency are supposed to be handled as strict accounting rules, temporary pilot behavior, or only a presentation-layer convention. We want to avoid a situation where the operational display becomes simpler, but the customer-visible totals no longer align cleanly with the underlying financial records.

Best,
Finance Dept.

Hi Team,

Before any implementation shortcut is taken, please clarify whether currency conversion, display format, and invoice currency are supposed to be handled as strict accounting rules, temporary pilot behavior, or only a presentation-layer convention. Best,
Finance Dept.

    And no discrepancies should exist between loyalty and financial records
